Local VoiceDesign runtime PASSED Fabio's listen - direction-following matches the tutorial. Library constraints captured: 50-100 voices, ElevenLabs-style grouping, folders-vs-filters open, unbounded-cast ceiling accepted, bring-your-own stays available.

DECISION: Qwen not shipped. Chatterbox + self-authored voice library. Qwen VoiceDesign demoted to bench authoring tool. Chatterbox multilingual (23 langs, takes reference) confirmed; accent must be baked at design time; multilingual clone durations anomalous.

NEGATIVE: accent is not controllable in Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign. 22 generations, 1 non-reproducible British hit, 0 non-British accents. Strong American prior. Library ships without author-designed accents; gender/age/type unaffected.
Emotion transfer WORKS at cfg_weight 0.3; node default 0.5 suppresses it. exaggeration and cfg_weight are coupled - Flow needs one intensity control, not two sliders. Per-emotion sweet spots differ.

Speaker-similarity QA gate built from Chatterbox's CAMPPlus encoder. Identity holds across emotions if acoustic prompt lines are frozen (voice-dependent). VC carries performance onto a character at 0.78-0.83 with no identity cost and better naturalness, but attenuates emotion; pushing the source caps at exaggeration ~1.2.

ARCHITECTURE SETTLED: TTS(perf clip, cfg 0.3, exag 1.2) -> VC(character clip). Library = ~60 neutral character clips + ~5-8 shared emotional performance clips. Emotion is a pipeline property, not a library one.
